capabilities.name: Account handoff
capabilities.summary: The day a deal closes, your client success manager gets one record: what was sold and promised, who is involved, the dates and billing terms as agreed, the risks the seller heard and what is still missing. Every next action has an owner.

capabilities.name: Churn risk and save plan
capabilities.summary: Once a quarter, the owner or account lead sees why customers really left, read from your own cancellation notes and records, how many left for each cause, and one change to try for each, with an owner, a start date and the count that will show whether it helped. A person decides every change.

capabilities.name: Client-status update preparation
capabilities.summary: Every client gets an accurate status update on schedule, drafted from the notes and the task list, with confirmed dates kept apart from estimates and the client’s open decisions in plain view.

capabilities.name: Customer onboarding plan
capabilities.summary: For every new customer, your customer success lead gets one plan for the first weeks: the result the customer must reach, the fewest milestones that get them there with an owner on each side, the promises both sides made, and each message as a draft. Nothing is sent until a person approves it.

capabilities.name: Quarterly business review preparation
capabilities.summary: Before each customer's quarterly review, the account manager gets a pack built on the customer's own goals: the quarter's result for each, labelled by where it came from, what is still open, next quarter's goals for discussion and a timed agenda. A person settles every question and sends it.

capabilities.name: Renewal risk review
capabilities.summary: Once a month, the account manager sees every contract coming up for renewal on one page: the dates that matter, the warning signs your organization watches for, which accounts are at risk, and the next step for each with an owner and a date. A person decides and makes every contact.
